pin_memory_tensor: pin_memory a torch.Tensor to copy it into pinned memory for faster CPU-to-GPU transfer
pin_memory_mapping_data: pin_memory a collections.abc.Mapping of tensors recursively converting all nested tensors to pinned memory
pin_memory_sequence_data: pin_memory a sequence of tensors converting each element into pinned memory
pin_memory_namedtuple_data: pin_memory a namedtuple containing tensors converting each field to pinned memory
pin_memory_tuple_data: pin_memory a plain tuple of tensors converting each element into pinned memory
